'''Michael Stock''' (also published as '''Mike Stock''')<ref name="dt-22685">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22685 QMC with a Bite], DeckTech (Michael "Son of Vader" Stock, 9 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22685/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22685/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010121221/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22685/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Son of Vader''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in April 2002. He also posted on DeckTech under the handle "Col. Sanders" (with a prank author name, not used here); see [[Michael Stock Dark Deal with Mains and Sabers]] and [[Michael Stock Solid Vitrual QMC]].
